title: Public Databases
description: Retrieve source-linked compound and protein records from the official PubChem and UniProt APIs.

tools.name: database_lookup_pubchem
tools.description: Look up a named compound or identifier in PubChem and return source-linked properties plus a locally parsed molecular structure artifact when SMILES is available.

query.description: Compound name, CID-compatible name, or registry identifier.

tools.name: database_lookup_uniprot
tools.description: Retrieve an accession from UniProtKB and return its protein name, organism, sequence, function annotations, PDB cross-references, and a sequence artifact.
